# DNS Owl
> DNS Owl provides managed DNS, domain monitoring, and related infrastructure tooling for domain owners and operators.

This site appears focused on DNS management and domain operations. The links below prioritize product, support, legal, and informational pages that help an LLM understand the service and its public resources.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://dnsowl.com/): Main overview of DNS Owl’s managed DNS and domain operations services.
- [Pricing](https://dnsowl.com/pricing): Pricing information for DNS Owl plans and service tiers.
- [Features](https://dnsowl.com/features): Summary of platform capabilities for DNS management and monitoring.
- [About](https://dnsowl.com/about): Company background and overview of the DNS Owl service.
- [Contact](https://dnsowl.com/contact): Contact options for sales, support, and general inquiries.

## Product
- [Managed DNS](https://dnsowl.com/managed-dns): Overview of managed authoritative DNS capabilities and service benefits.
- [DNS Monitoring](https://dnsowl.com/dns-monitoring): Information about DNS monitoring and alerting functionality.
- [Domain Monitoring](https://dnsowl.com/domain-monitoring): Details on monitoring domain status, changes, and availability.
- [Secondary DNS](https://dnsowl.com/secondary-dns): Information about secondary DNS support and redundancy options.
- [DNS Failover](https://dnsowl.com/dns-failover): Overview of failover features for resilient DNS operations.

## Support
- [Support](https://dnsowl.com/support): Central support page for customer help and service assistance.
- [Knowledge Base](https://dnsowl.com/knowledge-base): Help articles and answers for common platform questions.
- [Status](https://dnsowl.com/status): Service status and incident reporting for DNS Owl systems.
- [FAQ](https://dnsowl.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about service usage and billing.
- [Login](https://dnsowl.com/login): Customer login for accessing the DNS Owl platform.

## Documentation
- [Documentation](https://dnsowl.com/docs): Main documentation hub for setup and operational guidance.
- [Getting Started](https://dnsowl.com/docs/getting-started): Introductory setup steps for new DNS Owl users.
- [DNS Records](https://dnsowl.com/docs/dns-records): Reference information for supported DNS record types and usage.
- [Zone Management](https://dnsowl.com/docs/zone-management): Guidance for creating, editing, and maintaining DNS zones.
- [Monitoring Setup](https://dnsowl.com/docs/monitoring-setup): Instructions for configuring DNS and domain monitoring.
- [Account Settings](https://dnsowl.com/docs/account-settings): Documentation for account configuration and administrative settings.

## API & Integrations
- [API Overview](https://dnsowl.com/api): Overview of available API functionality and access patterns.
- [API Reference](https://dnsowl.com/api/reference): Endpoint-level reference for DNS Owl API operations.
- [Authentication](https://dnsowl.com/api/authentication): Details on authenticating requests to the DNS Owl API.
- [Zones API](https://dnsowl.com/api/zones): API operations for managing DNS zones and records.
- [Monitoring API](https://dnsowl.com/api/monitoring): API support for monitoring configuration and status retrieval.
- [Webhooks](https://dnsowl.com/api/webhooks): Information about webhook events and outbound notifications.

## Guides
- [Guides](https://dnsowl.com/guides): Collection of practical tutorials and operational walkthroughs.
- [Configure a Domain](https://dnsowl.com/guides/configure-a-domain): Step-by-step guide to setting up a domain with DNS Owl.
- [Migrate DNS](https://dnsowl.com/guides/migrate-dns): Instructions for moving existing DNS service to DNS Owl.
- [Set Up Failover](https://dnsowl.com/guides/set-up-failover): Walkthrough for configuring DNS failover behavior.
- [Monitor Domain Changes](https://dnsowl.com/guides/monitor-domain-changes): Guide to tracking domain and DNS changes over time.
- [Best Practices](https://dnsowl.com/guides/best-practices): Recommended operational practices for reliable DNS management.
